title: Pacific Mistress Sportfishing Dana Point
specs: Private charters only, no crowded party boats
Targets local species including Bluefin tuna, Yellowfin tuna, Mahi-Mahi, Yellowtail, Shark, White Seabass, Rockcod, Bonito, Calico Bass, Halibut
Valid California fishing licenses required for passengers 16 or older
Up to 4 passengers comfortably on vessel; 5th passenger possible for extra fee
includes: Fish cleaning, water, coffee, pillow/blankets provided on overnight trip
gap: Age minimum not explicitly stated for children under 16
blurb: Guests join private fishing charters ranging from 3-hour trips to extended overnight adventures. Trips target local species along Dana Point's coastline and beyond, with all fishing gear and amenities included. The vessel accommodates up to 4 passengers comfortably and features modern amenities including a bathroom and kitchen appliances.
extraNote: 50% deposit required for guided trips · Cancellation within 14 days forfeits deposit for guided trips · Trips may be cancelled due to weather with deposit refund if no reschedule possible · Dana Point Harbor
